_comment: Single source for every RustSec advisory exception. deny.toml [advisories].ignore and .cargo/audit.toml must match it exactly; packages/release/advisory-exceptions.mjs fails on missing fields, expired reviewBy, scope drift against Cargo.lock, or any mismatch. Renewal needs fresh evidence. Policy: Astra 2026-10-22, D:/scratch/rk-888/astra-advisories-answer.md. unaffectedVersions lists other locked versions of the same crate that the advisory does not cover. dependents is the exact set of Cargo.lock packages that directly depend on an affected version; the gate fails if a consumer is added or removed, and every hop of path must be a Cargo.lock dependency edge.

exceptions.rationale: Scope is the mitex DEFAULT_SPEC path only: the typeset wrapper passes None, so mitex deserializes its embedded include_bytes data and user LaTeX never becomes archive bytes.

ttf-parser is unmaintained (a maintenance notice, no vulnerability). It is a direct dependency of rightkit-pdf and also arrives through the typst and font stack (fontdb, lopdf, pixglyph, rustybuzz, typst-layout, typst-library, typst-render, typst-svg, usvg); the dependents set is pinned. Migration to skrifa is tracked in rightkit#890.
